description: Get data from an API. Example: query_api({api_id:"<from search_apis>", params:{state:"CA", limit:10}}). api_key is optional: without one, a free key is created and returned. Up to 50 records per call; every answer has the official source, read time and coverage.

api_key.description: Optional. Key from an earlier call or get_api_key; omit to get a free one.

name: query_api
title: Query an API
